:::{#sol-se-mean}

$$
\green{\SE{\hat\mu(\vx)}} =
\sqrt{\red{\Var{\hat\mu(\vx)}}}
$${#eq-se-sqrt-var-mean}

By the definition $\hat\mu(\vx) = \vx'\evb$
and [the variance of a linear combination](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#thm-var-lincom):

$$
\ba
\red{\Var{\hat\mu(\vx)}}
&= \Var{\vx'\evb}
\\
&= \vx'\Cov{\evb}\vx
\\
&= \red{\tp{\vx}\Sigma\vx}
\ea
$${#eq-var-mean}

where $\Sigma \eqdef \Covt(\evb)$.

---

::: notes

Expanding @eq-var-mean out of matrix-vector notation, we have:

:::

$$
\ba
\red{\tp{\vx}\Sigma\vx}
&= \sumip\sumjp x_i \Sigma_{ij} x_j
\\
&= \red{\sumip\sumjp x_i \Covt(\evb_i,\evb_j) x_j}
\ea
$$

---

Combining @eq-var-mean and the Gauss-Markov theorem:

:::{#thm-est-se-mean}

#### Estimated variance and standard error of predicted mean

$$
\orange{\eVar{\hat\mu(\vx)}} = \orange{\tp{\vx}\hat{\Sigma}\vx}
$${#eq-est-var-mean}

$$
\blue{\HSE{\hat\mu(\vx)}} =
\blue{\sqrt{\tp{\vx}\hat{\Sigma}\vx}}
$${#eq-est-se-mean}

:::

::: notes

Note: on the RHS, we have plugged in $\hat{\Sigma}$,
our estimate of $\Sigma$.

:::

:::
